card.name: Small linking words before dialysis or waking
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "on" or "under" in drug-label text, often right before a noun like dialysis, waking, overdose or a study type. It sometimes fires on "All" or "vere" too.

modes.label: Of before dialysis or waking
modes.description: The word "of" after timing, use or management, just before dialysis, waking or going to bed.
modes.example: Alogliptin tablets may be administered without regard to the timing<< of>> dialysis.

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Words such as "on" or "under" before hemodialysis or anesthetic agents.
modes.example: There is inadequate information regarding the use of meropenem for injection in patients<< on>> hemodialysis or peritoneal dial
